
join hortbot 999 foobar 1


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply add *hey_there* Hey. (_REGULARS_ONLY_)
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Autoreply #1 added.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :Hey there.
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Hey.

clock_forward 1m

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=subscriber :Hey there.
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Hey.

clock_forward 1m

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :Hey there.
no_send
